cutover.rule: Fresh Supabase-managed environments apply application-schema.sql, then bootstrap-data.sql, then only active migrations with a version greater than 20260801000000. current-schema.sql is captured authority and derivation input, not the executable local-stack artifact. Existing production continues to use its unchanged historical ledger.

captured_production_authority.purpose: Exact schema-only evidence and deterministic derivation source.

exclusion_rules.description: Exclude CREATE/ALTER SCHEMA statements for the Supabase-managed extensions schema.
Exclude CREATE/ALTER/COMMENT statements for functions owned by the extensions schema.
Exclude GRANT/REVOKE statements whose target is in the Supabase-managed extensions schema.

bootstrap_configuration_and_data.classification: application-owned non-secret bootstrap configuration and seed data

authority.safety: current-schema.sql is schema-only captured authority with no COPY/INSERT data section, credentials, connection strings, signed URLs, or client rows. application-schema.sql is the canonical executable projection for a Supabase-managed local stack.

verification_scope.captured_snapshot: Exact byte equality by SHA-256 between current-schema.sql and the provenance-bound external schema-only dump.
verification_scope.executable_projection: Exact deterministic generation of application-schema.sql from current-schema.sql using the recorded platform-owned exclusion rules, plus successful disposable execution.
verification_scope.rebuilt_catalogue: Identifier multiset only: table names, column names, constraint names, enum names/ordered values, public function names, view names, trigger names, policy names, index names, RLS-enabled table flags, selected storage bucket/policy names, and two seed identities. It does not compare function bodies, policy expressions, constraint definitions, index definitions, or ACLs.
verification_scope.policies: RLS-enabled flags for all public tables and total policy/name catalogue; symmetric behavior is representative for clients and organic_master, not exhaustive policy-expression behavior.
verification_scope.grants: Six service-role-only RPC privilege checks are representative. Captured GRANT/REVOKE statement hashes are inventoried but complete rebuilt ACL equivalence is not asserted.
verification_scope.behavioral_database: Named representative constraints, foreign keys/actions, uniqueness, and begin_ideation_run idempotency cases; not exhaustive database behavior.

classification_legend.existed at the foundation cutover: Not assigned where the stub is the only historical DDL evidence; exact claims are intentionally withheld.
classification_legend.introduced by a later active migration: A repository migration creates or names the object/column/constraint.
classification_legend.held or intentionally excluded: Outside the active migration directory and absent from the baseline.
classification_legend.production-only or externally configured: Supabase platform state or operator-managed state outside the public schema dump.
classification_legend.generated or extension-managed: Owned by the Supabase local stack or a PostgreSQL extension.
classification_legend.unresolved: Current snapshot object with no provable later repository introduction; exact foundation membership cannot be proven.
